articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act still at mercy of ethics section as Democrats balk at Trump deal
articles.snippet: The White House has circulated some details of the conflict-of-interest limits the president agreed to with Republican negotiators, but talks are still underway.

articles.title: White House pushes Senate Democrats to take 'historic' crypto Clarity Act ethics deal
articles.snippet: Without revealing any details about the actual agreement from President Trump on potential presidential restrictions, his White House is urging its acceptance.

articles.title: SecondFi to wind down after $2.6M ADA theft linked to wallet flaw
articles.snippet: SecondFi will wind down after a $2.6 million ADA theft, while users still await recovery tools that were initially expected within weeks of the exploit.

articles.title: Balaji’s Network School turns to Kazakhstan amid Malaysia setback
articles.snippet: The agreement gives Balaji Srinivasan’s tech community a potential new base as Malaysian authorities clamp down on the Network School over alleged licensing breaches.

articles.title: Galaxy Commits Up to $5 Million to Prepare Bitcoin for Quantum Threat
articles.snippet: The crypto firm's initiative arrives as researchers, exchanges, and the U.S. government warn that "Q-Day" may land as soon as 2030.
